column3: The meltwater is rising\nand the sandbags are gone.{page_break}Could you spare 150 coins\nfor more?{end_now}
Thank you. The lower\nstreets will hold a while\nlonger.{end_wait}
I understand. We will\nkeep stacking what we\nhave.{end_wait}
The new bags are holding.\nThank you, stranger.{end_wait}
No coins to spare?\nNeither have we. Stay safe.{end_wait}
Take it. Keep the water\nout of the houses.{end_wait}

We came for the festival.
Now no ship will sail and
our money is gone.{page_break}Could you lend 400 coins
for our road home?{end_now}
You are kind. We will\nnever forget it.{end_wait}
I understand. Everyone\nis short of coins now.{end_wait}
We are leaving at dawn.\nBless you, young warrior.{end_wait}
You have no coins to\nspare? Neither do we.\nGo safely, warrior.{end_wait}
